messages:
Alex T: kicking off a short thread — want to align on a playbook for capturing product signals from design partners during the beta window. goal: make decisions, not just collect noise.
Priya R: +1. can we scope to recruitment targets, feedback cadence, instrumentation, and success criteria?
Alex T: exactly. sketching a few things below, please react w/ :thumbsup: if this looks reasonable or suggest changes.
Alex T: Recruitment: target 10-12 teams total, split 6 platform teams (SaaS/product feature owners) + 4 marketplace/ops teams. aim for diversity in infra (hosted, dedicated, private).
Priya R: timeline: outreach 2 weeks, onboard in week 4, 6-week beta period per cohort. cohort size tradeoff = depth vs signal. prefer smaller cohorts (4–6) to get richer sessions.
Sara K: for CS ops, we need commitments: 1 product owner + 1 technical point-of-contact from partner, weekly 30m check-ins, and access to logs (with consent). will prepare a participant checklist.
Marco G: instrumentation ask: we need event-level signals + session traces. minimal event set: 
```
{
  "events": [
    "invocation.start",
    "invocation.end",
    "response.latency_ms",
    "cache.hit",
    "model.variant",
    "prompt.template_id",
    "human_feedback_rating"
  ]
}
```
Jamie L: we'll add a lightweight SDK hook to capture those, can ship a test harness. need to know retention window for logs.
Sara K: retention: default 90 days. for DP we can ask for extended 180 days for analysis. legal sign-off needed for PII removal.
onboard-bot: Reminder: Attach NDA link and onboarding doc to the thread when you have recruiter list.
Priya R: Feedback cadence: weekly asynchronous write-ups + 2x structured interviews (week 2 and week 5). deliverable: weekly "signal memo" (1 pager) summarizing top 3 friction points, 1 success story, 2 candidate improvements.
Alex T: Success criteria (proposal):
- Quantitative: at least 8/10 partners schedule weekly sessions; median response latency improvement or cost delta measured; feature adoption: >=30% of partner calls use new API flow within 2 weeks.
- Qualitative: >=70% of partners rate feature as "valuable" (5/7) in week 5 interview; clear path to roadmap action (>=3 prioritized changes).
Priya R: Add safety/law criteria: no unresolved security/blocker issues (P0/P1) open at launch; data handling documented and approved.
Jamie L: Launch gating: canary to 2 partners first, then open to remaining cohort after 72h and health checks pass. health checks: error rate < 0.5%, latency p95 within agreed SLO.
Alex T: Outputs we need from each cohort: recruitment notes, onboarding checklist, instrumentation dump + dashboard, 1 pager signal memo, prioritized backlog with owner.
Marco G: I'll stand up a dashboard template in Console: per-partner latency, tokens per invocation, cache-hit rate, and a qualitative notes field. ETA: 5 working days.
Priya R: Recruitment messaging: emphasize low-effort integration, clear benefits (reduced latency, cost controls, early access to optimizations), and participation perks (credits + visibility on roadmap + 1:1 design session).
Sara K: On incentives — keep it modest (cloud credits + dedicated Q/A slot). no large $$ to avoid biasing feedback.
Alex T: Measurement plan for decisions: require at least 3 corroborating signals (quant metric + interview + usage trace) before committing to a roadmap change.
Priya R: Roll call: who owns what?
Alex T: I own decision criteria and roadmap tie-ins.
Priya R: I own recruitment and partner ops.
Sara K: I own the participant onboarding checklist and weekly CS touchpoints.
Marco G: I own the instrumentation and dashboard.
Jamie L: I own the SDK/harness + canary rollout plan.
Alex T: Risks: sample bias, partners too consultative (ask but not use), data privacy concerns. mitigation: diversify verticals, set clear "usage" milestone, pre-agree data access.
Priya R: Next steps:
1) Priya: finalize outreach list by EOW (Fri).
2) Marco: dashboard skeleton by next Wed.
3) Jamie: test harness + canary script by next Tue.
4) Sara: onboarding checklist + NDA template by EOW.
5) Alex: final success criteria and decision rubric by next Mon.
Alex T: Can folks confirm ownership & ETA with a quick reply? :eyes:
Priya R: confirmed — will share list by Fri. :white_check_mark:
Marco G: confirmed — dashboard Wed. :rocket:
Jamie L: confirmed — harness Tue, will post commands to test here.
Sara K: confirmed — checklist + NDA by Fri.
onboard-bot: Note: NDA template updated 2026-02-12.
Alex T: great. will compile into a 1-pager playbook after these deliverables and ping execs for approval. thanks team! :party_parrot:
